entities.title: Agents
entities.summary: The skills and the knowledge catalogue an agent follows to document a repository in .dev folders and Actors/, with a validator for each.
entities.purpose: Skills/ holds one folder per skill: the describe-* skills for the four diagrams, the five behavior views, actors and knowledge files, and populate-dev, which decides what a folder needs; each view skill has a schema and a fictional example, and validate_diagrams.py checks them and every view in a repository. Knowledge/ holds the catalogue of knowledge kinds: a schema per kind, common.schema.json, a fictional example per kind and validate_knowledge.py.
boundaries: Skills/ and Knowledge/ are copied whole to Meta/Agents/Skills/ and Meta/Agents/Knowledge/ in other repositories. The skills' instructions name those paths, and validate_diagrams.py's default repository root assumes them (see the backlog); Agents/ itself and its .dev folder are not copied.
Every example.json, every describe-actor example.md and every file in Knowledge/examples/ is fictional and says so: they describe a made-up worker in src/ExampleWorker, not this repository.
No .dev folder inside Skills/ or Knowledge/: what is recorded about them is kept here until the open decision in this folder is taken.
The validators check that files are well-formed, not that they are true; truth is checked by reading the sources a file cites.
